sources.title: AI-assisted mask generation - Metashape Expert Manual
sources.snippet: The AI is designed to segment a single foreground; behaviour with multiple co-equal objects is unattested and may produce incomplete masks. The capture is aerial or landscape. The model wasn't trained for these scenarios. The subject and background share visual structure (e.g. a ceramic vessel against a textured cloth in similar tones).
